battery_checks.label: Local additive homogeneity
battery_checks.proposed_action: Use a small prespecified set of local window scales to expose enrichment/depletion and compare reviewed neighbours. Windows remain within-site summaries, not extra samples.

battery_checks.label: Void width, fraction and depth structure
battery_checks.proposed_action: Review visible macrovoid structure; distinguish equivalent section diameter from local medial-axis width and from 3-D throats. More void space is not universally better.
battery_checks.validation_needed: Independent void labels and preparation/edge-scope checks; wetting, loading/density and 3-D transport evidence before transport ranking.

battery_checks.label: Particle-fracture appearance in fresh material
battery_checks.proposed_action: Review internal lines and particle outlines across detectors. Low ridge-pixel coverage is not an intact-particle fraction; visible fractures are not prior cycling damage.
battery_checks.validation_needed: Expert fracture labels and detection-limit/preparation checks; powder/process history and subsequent cycling evidence for failure mechanisms.
